effectivePoint: After run-02 first-output external review; before any user correction prompts
reason: A managed-store platform limitation is common to the first two outputs, but run-02 also has an independently observed blank main area and missing navigation. Stopping all work at the storage boundary would prevent measuring whether extra guidance repairs the otherwise testable application.
clarification: Stop attempts to cross the managed-persistence provisioning boundary. Independent UI/workflow defects may still receive up to the existing maximum of two symptom-only corrections. Do not provision external tables, publish or access organizational records. Retain the storage failure and do not call the app accepted.
appliesTo: Every configuration, including earlier runs if they have an independently observed non-storage defect. Run-01 had none, so no corrective prompt is warranted there.
disclosure: This is a documented pilot protocol amendment, not a retrospectively pre-registered rule.
